answers.explanation: Once the recipients are accepted, DATA starts the message.
451 is a temporary local error, and greylisting uses exactly this code.
A space marks the final line of the reply.
Each recipient is accepted or refused on its own. The 550 one gets a bounce sent back to the sender.
252 is a polite non-answer. Saying yes or no would help spammers.
5xx is permanent. The sender gets a bounce.
RSET drops the transaction in progress but keeps the session.
